pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with irregular, crenulated edges exhibiting smooth pixel gradients; spatial area of patches is notably larger on the mid-flank compared to the elongated, smaller patches on the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light tan pathways forming a reticulum with predominantly tri-valent junction nodes; pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible 1D contour along the neck and upper shoulder showing a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette composed of dark bristles.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A distinct, vertically elongated region of dark textural disruption and hyper-pigmentation is visible at the base of the neck and upper shoulder, significantly interrupting the typical pelage pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark, vertical lesion or physical trauma mark located at the transition between the neck and shoulder, showing total disruption of the local patch-and-corridor geometry.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism perched on the dorsal ridge of the upper neck, characterized by a dark silhouette against the background.
